FN-EJGJW2C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 341
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/10/2026
Senate Bill 341 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Transportation and the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency by an undetermined amount
dependent on the cost of the installation and operation of photographic speed enforcement
systems in works zones on public highways, as provided by this bill. These obligations would be
offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of a $250 fine for each violation, as provided by this
bill, the proceeds of which would be distributed evenly between the Public Safety Fund and the
Public Road and Bridge Fund.
Additionally, this bill could increase receipts to the circuit courts by an undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of court costs collected for being found liable for a work zone
speeding violation after an adjudicative hearing or for failing to appear for such adjudicative
hearing.
This bill could decrease potential receipts to the State General Fund and other various funds
where court costs for traffic violations are distributed by an undetermined amount dependent on
the amount of fines and court costs for any work zone traffic violations that otherwise would
have been collected under current law, absent this bill.
